meta.name: zephyr-module
meta.description: Creating and integrating out-of-tree Zephyr modules. Covers module.yml configuration, Kconfig and CMake integration within a module, and West manifest inclusion. Trigger when developing reusable libraries, driver packages, or external software components for Zephyr.
